Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - HealthSync (clarifying questions)

Hi Janelle / Mike 

Great to speak with both of you this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side re: the security intake:

- Priority items discussed: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, and vendor questionnaire (SIG vs CAIQ).
- You mentioned HealthSync prefers CAIQ but will verify with security.

Action items I'll take on:
1) Attach a blank SIG/CAIQ workbook we commonly use for vendor intake (attached).
2) Ask a few clarifying questions below to make sure we send the right artifacts and avoid back-and-forth.

Clarifying questions (please confirm):
- Do you handle PHI in scope for this integration? If so, which data flows will touch PHI (e.g., patient identifiers, notes, documents)?
- SOC 2: do you need Redwood to share a SOC 2 Type 2 report or is a SOC 2 Type 1 + evidence sufficient for initial review?
- Encryption/data residency: Do you have a required region (US/EU) or specific encryption at rest requirements beyond industry standard AES-256?
- Questionnaire format: you said CAIQ preferred — is a completed CAIQ spreadsheet acceptable, or would your team still ask us to complete a custom vendor intake form?

If you can reply with the answers and your security mailing list (or security@healthsync.com), I'll route the questionnaire and attach the SOC reports and any certs we have.

Attached: HealthSync_SIG_Request_20260509.xlsx, Redwood_SIG_Guidance.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a short follow-up with your security team if that speeds things up.

Best,

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - HealthSync (clarifying questions)

Hi Camila 

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the workbook. Answers inline below: 

- PHI scope: yes, some flows will contain PHI (patient name + MRN + limited clinical notes). We can share a data-flow diagram in the follow-up.
- SOC 2: For procurement, we prefer SOC 2 Type 2, but if you can provide Type 1 + interim evidence we can start initial legal/security review (full Type 2 requested prior to production onboarding).
- Data residency/encryption: We require customer data to be stored in the US for this account. AES-256 at rest is required; TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- Questionnaire format: CAIQ is fine — our security team uses CAIQ as the canonical format. If you can complete CAIQ first that will speed review.

Security contact: security@healthsync.com (cc'd). Our security lead Mike Nguyen (cc'd) will coordinate the deeper review.

I'll loop in our security team next week for a short intake call.

Thanks,
Janelle Carter
Head of Partnerships, HealthSync
janelle.carter@healthsync.com | (650) 555-0987

Thanks Janelle 

A couple technical clarifications from the SE side to avoid surprises on the CAIQ: 

1) PHI handling: For the flows that include PHI, can you confirm whether HealthSync will send documents/files directly to our ingestion endpoint or if data will be routed through an SFTP or VPC peering arrangement? This affects our recommended data controls and keystore options.

2) Tokenization / PII minimization: Are you expecting Redwood to perform any deterministic tokenization on identifiers before storage, or will HealthSync manage tokenization on their side?

3) Expected timeline: when would you like the CAIQ and SOC artifacts returned? We can aim for a completed CAIQ within 3-5 business days once we have the exact PHI flows and the target region confirmed.

If easier, we can do a short 30-min technical intake with your security engineer next week (proposed windows: Tue 5/12 10–12 PT or Wed 5/13 1–3 PT).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
